name: waveform_trim
description: Detect silence — outputs trim spec JSON with keep ranges. No video encode.

input.description: Source video file (use 'inputs' for batch parallel processing)

output.description: Trim spec: {input, keeps} — or array of trim specs for batch

params.name: min-silence
params.description: Minimum silence duration to remove in seconds

params.name: out
params.description: Write the JSON it would print to this file instead (the trim spec, or with 'inputs' the array of trim specs), and print {"path": "<abs path>"} instead. Pass a single spec's path as --input to a downstream step (e.g. rm_nonspeech) to chain.
